name: Alex Berger
bio: Alex Berger is a UX designer and web developer from Graz, Austria. He enjoys creating simple and user-friendly websites.
additionalBio: He is passionate about technology, design, and improving digital experiences. In his free time, he enjoys photography, travelling, and learning new skills.
